author: Ari Koslow
title: Dustin May (ankle) feeling better Friday
desc: Cardinals manager Oliver Marmol and Dustin May both said that his right ankle felt better than expected on Friday.
impact: May was forced to depart Thursday's start in Atlanta in the opening frame because of a comebacker that struck him on the ankle. He had initial X-rays return negative on the injury.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Oswaldo Cabrera optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Yankees optioned Oswaldo Cabrera to Triple-A.
impact: Cabrera will return to Triple-A with Ryan McMahon activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Rodon (elbow) placed on IL
desc: The Yankees placed Carlos Rodon on the 15-day injured list with left elbow inflammation.
impact: It appears Rodon may have suffered the injury in his last start. He does not hold a timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trent Grisham (hamstring) activated from IL
desc: The Yankees activated Trent Grisham from the injured list.
impact: Grisham was placed on the injured list with a right hamstring strain a few weeks ago. He returns for Friday's series opener against the Twins.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan McMahon (infection) activated from IL
desc: The Yankees activated Ryan McMahon from the injured list.
impact: McMahon landed on the injured list with a throat/ear infection last week. He returns for Friday's series opener against the Twins.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ke'Bryan Hayes (back) sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Reds sent Ke'Bryan Hayes on a rehab assignment at High-A Dayton.
impact: Hayes will likely require playing in at least a handful of rehab games. He'll likely be activated right before or after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Vasquez has X-rays return negative
desc: Padres manager Craig Stammen said "X-rays were negative and all tests came back pretty clean" for Randy Vasquez.
impact: Vasquez was hospitalized after fainting at Dodger Stadium on Thursday. He'll continue to be further evaluated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Bowman opts out of contract with Blue Jays
desc: Matt Bowman opted out of his contract with the Blue Jays.
impact: Toronto has until Saturday to add him or release him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Janson Junk to make rehab start Friday
desc: Janson Junk will make his second rehab start for Triple-A Jacksonville on Friday.
impact: Junk had X-rays return negative after getting injured on his rehab assignment. He will likely be activated after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Drew Pomeranz to join Cubs in majors
desc: The Cubs are calling up Drew Pomeranz.
impact: Pomeranz had signed a minor league contract with the Cubs. Jordan Wicks was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Wicks officially optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Cubs optioned Jordan Wicks to Triple-A Iowa.
impact: The move was reported on Thursday and becomes official on Friday. Drew Pomeranz was called up as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Gusto optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Marlins optioned Ryan Gusto to Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Gusto will return to Triple-A with William Kempner getting called up.

author: Ari Koslow
title: William Kempner recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Marlins recalled William Kempner from Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Kempner will add a fresh arm for Miami heading into the weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rob Zastryzny (trap) sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Brewers say Rob Zastryzny will begin a rehab assignment in the Arizona Complex League on Friday.
impact: Zastryzny will figure to make a handful of rehab appearances before he is activated later in July.

author: Nate Miller
title: Franco Aleman heads back to bigs
desc: Franco Aleman was recalled by the Guardians ahead of Friday's game against the White Sox.
impact: Aleman made a pair of relief appearances with the Guardians back in May, giving up one run on three hits and one walk with one strikeout across 2 2/3 innings. The 26-year-old righty has been impressively dominant for Triple-A Columbus this year, surrendering only one earned run while posting a 43-7 K/BB ratio across 28 1/3 innings.
